algebra.absolute_equation_proof: Put y=x-2. For a>0, y>0, and |y-1/y|=a has exactly one root on each side of 1. a<0 follows by reflection; a=0 gives y=+-1. Always two distinct real roots; never four.

complexity.rank_bucket_lower_bound: With n items in k=n^(2/3) nonempty equal-value classes, sum c_i(c_i-1)/2 >= (n^2/k-n)/2 = Omega(n^(4/3)), contradicting Theta(n) duplicate pairs. Distinct-value ranks identify equality; a bucket cannot contain unequal values as the author claims.
complexity.bst_distinct_count: m <= n; the asserted m=n^omega(1) regime is impossible.

ecology.c1q0_missing_condition: Equal intake shares do not determine production attribution without equal conversion efficiencies. 100 kJ total production can be split 50/50 or 40/60, giving transfer 12.5% or 10% from 400 kJ zooplankton. Both preserve equal intake by choosing different conversion efficiencies.
ecology.c3q1_definition: The supplied source defines transfer efficiency as predator production attributable to prey divided by TOTAL prey production. The stem already gives herbivore production=600 kJ; the author changes the denominator to consumption and invents an information gap.
